title: Editorial recovery and permissions validated; isolated build corrections
summary: 137 automated cases, 8 browser scenarios and 7 native PostgreSQL 18.6 checks pass. Production build remains in progress after correcting snapshot omissions and disk exhaustion.

changes.detail: Read-only French/Arabic suggestion previews for product editors; private payloads and global budget data excluded. Restricted global AI controls are not mounted for product-only staff.
Separate hashed six-migration review manifest and fresh loopback-only native concurrency/privilege rehearsal; old five-file plans unchanged.
Isolated build snapshot now includes shared mobile/learning and test-helper dependencies. A disk-space guard and disabled disposable webpack cache address ENOSPC.

Only this session?s three disposable .next/cache directories and one superseded generated browser bundle were removed to recover disk space. No source, previous release, report or evidence log was removed.

validation.name: Real Chrome synthetic fixture
validation.detail: 8 scenarios; 375/768/1440 widths, RTL, tab recovery, conflict merge, storage failure, permission UI and publication controls. Not hosted auth/PostgREST acceptance.

validation.name: Native SQL
validation.detail: 7 checks on fresh PostgreSQL 18.6 loopback cluster; concurrent save/publish/rollback, source locking, transaction rollback, actual role grants/RLS. Cluster stopped. Not PostgreSQL 17.11 certification.

validation.name: Types and focused lint
validation.detail: Root and learning TypeScript exit 0; focused ESLint exit 0. Last build-runner adjustment will be linted again.

validation.name: Earlier production-build attempts
validation.detail: First snapshot omitted shared mobile sources and fonts were network-blocked; second omitted a test helper; third exhausted disk during cache writes. Logs retained; corrected cache-disabled retry running.

validation.name: Hosted acceptance
validation.detail: No hosted access/writes, migrations, deployment, worker activation, paid requests, credentials or CLI link changes.
